tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Check whether a date is a business day in South Africa (not a weekend or SA public holiday). Returns the reason if it isn't.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Add (or subtract, with a negative number) South African business days to a date, skipping weekends and SA public holidays. Use for payment terms, notice periods and delivery dates. (paid via Apify)

tools.name: business_days_between
tools.description: Count South African business days between two dates (excludes the start date, includes the end date). (paid via Apify)

tools.name: holidays_in_range
tools.description: List South African public holidays between two dates, including Sunday-to-Monday observed days and once-off declared holidays. (paid via Apify)

tools.name: days_until_next_holiday
tools.description: Find the next South African public holiday after a date and how many calendar days until it. Includes observed and once-off declared holidays.

tools.name: next_sars_deadlines
tools.description: List the next SARS EMP201 (PAYE) and VAT201 due dates from a given date, adjusted for weekends and public holidays. Monthly VAT vendors; bi-monthly vendors use only their period-end months. (paid via Apify)
